sloka: प्रविश्य वदनं मेऽद्य गन्तव्यं वानरोत्तम ।वर एष पुरा दत्तो मम धात्रेति सत्वरा ॥५-१-१५९॥
transliteration: praviśya vadanaṁ me'dya gantavyaṁ vānarottama ।vara eṣa purā datto mama dhātreti satvarā ॥5-1-159॥

translations.english: "O best vanara you must pass through my mouth today. Such is the boon granted to me by Brahma in the past". Then she quickly opened her big mouth and stood.
